lines.text: After His suffering, Jesus appeared to the apostles over a span of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
Jesus commanded the apostles not to leave Jerusalem but to wait for the gift the Father promised.
The apostles asked if Jesus would restore the kingdom to Israel, and He said the Father fixed the times by His own authority.
Jesus said the apostles would receive power from the Holy Spirit and be His witnesses in Jerusalem, Judea, Samaria, and Egypt.

wrong_details.true: to the ends of the earth

lines.text: A whirlwind hid Jesus as He was taken up, and two men in white said He will return the same way.
